# GitHub Copilot Custom Instructions

## Commit Message

本仓库的 commit message 规范只有一份正文，见
`<% .AiAssistant %>/rules/git-commit-message.md`

生成 commit message 前请先读它：emoji 与类型对照表、正文格式、硬性要求都在那里
本文件以前内嵌过一份自己的 emoji 表，与 Trae 的那份冲突（feat 一个 🔥 一个 ✨，
refactor 一个 ♻️ 一个 🧹），已合并掉

[EN] The commit message convention has a single source of truth at
`<% .AiAssistant %>/rules/git-commit-message.md`. Read it before generating a commit message:
the emoji table, body format and hard rules all live there. This file used to carry its own
emoji table that contradicted Trae's copy; the two have been merged

## 触发词 | Trigger phrases

`生成 commit`、`commit message`、`分析改动`、`git diff`、`@commit`
